name: heading
description: A section heading. Levels form an outline: h2 for sections, h3 inside them, never skipping a level; the layout gives the page's one h1.

use.when: a section starts; span 12, frame bare.
use.not: emphasis, or a label a component already shows.
use.with: the outline: h2 for sections, h3 inside them.

id.description: Anchor for links: lowercase words joined by hyphens, unique on the page.

wcag.notes: Headings are how screen reader users and agents build a page outline (2.4.10 section headings). Keep them short and descriptive.

machine.identify: The element name is h1 to h6. Read aria-level from the tag number.
machine.operate: Not interactive. Use headings to locate sections; most screen readers jump between them with the H key.
